verdict: A strong lead spike this week, but quality and staying power need confirming.
narrative: Lead volume surged 1,300% over the last 7 days compared to the prior 7, driven by your Google Local Services Ads campaign, which brought your 28-day cost per lead down to $91.55. That burst appears to have slowed in the final three days of the window, so we're watching closely to see whether the efficiency holds or reflects a short-term spike. Several planned milestones — including heating campaign activation and fall creative — are past due, and getting those live is the clearest path to making this momentum sustainable. Expect a clearer read on lead quality and volume stability by next week's report.

watch_item.issue: The recent lead spike may be fading — daily lead volume dropped sharply in the last three days of the period, and the heating campaigns and fall creative that would sustain it are still not live.
